blueprint.name: initramfs-smoke
blueprint.description: Standalone initramfs with an executable smoke-test init.

files.data:
#!/usr/bin/bash
/usr/bin/mount -t devtmpfs devtmpfs /dev
exec >/dev/console 2>&1
if [[ $(</etc/initrd-release) == ID=initramfs-smoke ]]; then
    printf 'image-builder initramfs: PASS\n'
else
    printf 'image-builder initramfs: FAIL\n'
fi
/usr/bin/mount -t proc proc /proc
printf o >/proc/sysrq-trigger
read -r -t 60 _ </dev/console
